display.purpose: Names the active Language at the top of an Operate surface.

headline.purpose: Names the dominant task or card.

title.purpose: Labels Lessons, actions, and decisive rows.

label.purpose: Labels dashboard destinations, statuses, and eyebrows.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Temporary feedback overlays only; permanent cards remain tonal and bordered.

motion.name: press-compact
motion.purpose: Restrained press feedback for compact controls.

motion.name: progress
motion.purpose: Communicates a real change in mastered progress.

motion.name: accordion
motion.purpose: Rotates expansion affordances and reveals Unit content.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Immediate state replacement when reduced motion is enabled.

components.name: Louisiana Primary Action
components.description: The strongest next action when Louisiana French is active.
components.css: .ds-button-cajun { background:#2771CB; color:#FFFFFF; border:0; border-radius:12px; padding:13px 16px; min-height:44px; font:800 15px/1.3 system-ui,sans-serif; transition:transform 150ms ease,filter 150ms ease; } .ds-button-cajun:hover { filter:brightness(.94); } .ds-button-cajun:active { transform:scale(.97); } .ds-button-cajun:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #7DD3FC; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Kouri Primary Action
components.description: The strongest next action when Kouri-Vini is active.
components.css: .ds-button-kouri { background:#08834C; color:#FFFFFF; border:0; border-radius:12px; padding:13px 16px; min-height:48px; font:800 15px/1.3 system-ui,sans-serif; transition:transform 150ms ease,filter 150ms ease; } .ds-button-kouri:hover { filter:brightness(.94); } .ds-button-kouri:active { transform:scale(.97); } .ds-button-kouri:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #6EE7B7; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Dashboard Action
components.description: A compact labeled destination inside a saturated Language field.
components.css: .ds-dashboard { position:relative; display:grid; justify-items:center; gap:6px; min-width:64px; min-height:64px; padding:0; border:0; background:transparent; color:#FFFFFF; font:700 11px/1.2 system-ui,sans-serif; transition:transform 150ms ease; } .ds-dashboard-icon { display:grid; place-items:center; width:46px; height:46px; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.30); border-radius:999px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.18); font-size:22px; } .ds-dashboard b { position:absolute; top:-4px; right:4px; border-radius:999px; padding:1px 6px; background:#FFCD00; color:#102A43; font:900 10px/1.2 system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-dashboard:active { transform:scale(.94); } .ds-dashboard:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #FFFFFF; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Daily Plan
components.description: A dark prioritized work field with progress state and one next action.
components.css: .ds-plan { width:320px; border-radius:18px; padding:18px; background:#102A43; color:#FFFFFF; font-family:system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-plan header { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:baseline; } .ds-plan strong { font-size:18px; font-weight:900; } .ds-plan header span { color:#7DD3FC; font-size:12px; font-weight:700; } .ds-plan-steps { display:flex; align-items:center; margin:16px 0; } .ds-plan-steps i { display:grid; place-items:center; width:30px; height:30px; border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35); border-radius:999px; font-style:normal; font-weight:900; } .ds-plan-steps i:first-child { border:0; background:#7DD3FC; color:#102A43; } .ds-plan-steps em { flex:1; height:3px; margin:0 8px; border-radius:2px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.18); } .ds-plan button { width:100%; min-height:44px; border:0; border-radius:12px; background:#2771CB; color:#FFFFFF; font-weight:800; } .ds-plan button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #7DD3FC; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Unit Card
components.description: A Catalog container combining Language identity, metadata, and visible progress.
components.css: .ds-unit { overflow:hidden; width:320px; border:1px solid #E2E8F0; border-radius:18px; background:#FFFFFF; font-family:system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-unit header { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:16px; background:linear-gradient(180deg,#498BDC,#2771CB); color:#FFFFFF; } .ds-unit header>b { border-radius:999px; padding:6px 10px; background:#FFFFFF; color:#2771CB; font-size:12px; font-weight:900; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-unit span { display:grid; gap:4px; } .ds-unit strong { font-size:17px; font-weight:800; } .ds-unit small { color:rgba(255,255,255,.88); font-size:12.5px; font-weight:600; } .ds-progress { height:10px; background:#E2E8F0; } .ds-progress i { display:block; width:38%; height:100%; background:#7DD3FC; transition:width 400ms ease; }

components.name: Lesson Row
components.description: A dense Catalog row with explicit progress copy and a short pill action.
components.css: .ds-lesson { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; width:320px; min-height:48px; padding:12px 14px; border:0; border-top:1px solid #F1F5F9; background:#FFFFFF; color:#102A43; text-align:left; font-family:system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-lesson span { display:grid; gap:4px; } .ds-lesson strong { font-size:14.5px; font-weight:800; } .ds-lesson small { color:#64748B; font-size:13px; } .ds-lesson>b { border-radius:999px; padding:7px 12px; background:#2771CB; color:#FFFFFF; font-size:12.5px; font-weight:800; } .ds-lesson:hover { background:#F4F7FB; } .ds-lesson:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #7DD3FC; outline-offset:-3px; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: A high-contrast count attached to the action it qualifies.
components.css: .ds-badge-review,.ds-badge-danger { display:inline-block; min-width:12px; border-radius:999px; padding:1px 6px; text-align:center; font:900 10px/1.2 system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-badge-review { background:#FFCD00; color:#102A43; } .ds-badge-danger { background:#DC2626; color:#FFFFFF; }

narrative.overview: The system behaves like a compact instrument panel for learning: Language identity is unmistakable, current state is legible at a glance, and one truthful next action leads. It is optimistic without becoming game-like, using saturated Language fields above calm, cool surfaces. Home establishes the reusable world rather than donating its exact composition to every screen.
keyCharacteristics: Two equal Language identities, never a primary brand plus a secondary variant.
Compact, confident controls with explicit labels and state.
Tonal hierarchy built from color fields, borders, and progress fills.
Dense information arranged in one calm reading order.
System typography and native behavior before decorative novelty.

rules.name: The Language Role Rule
rules.body: Blue and green occupy identical semantic roles; a Language switch changes values, never component hierarchy.

rules.name: The Badge Contrast Rule
rules.body: Gold uses dark ink, red uses white, and neither badge color becomes decoration.

rules.name: The Weight Carries Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Use the established weight ladder before adding typefaces, colors, or decorative treatments.

rules.name: The Tonal Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: A permanent surface earns separation through color, border, or containment before shadow.

rules.name: The Shape Means Role Rule
rules.body: Preserve the circle, pill, control, and card roles across screens instead of choosing radii per element.

dos: Do keep Louisiana French and Kouri-Vini structurally identical while swapping the complete semantic palette.
Do derive visible progress and status from real Learner Progress and Catalog data.
Do use system typography, safe-area insets, native touch targets, and platform navigation behavior.
Do keep labels visible beside or beneath unfamiliar icons.
Do preserve the bundled flags, pelican, and second-line artwork at deliberate identity moments.
donts: Don't let several full-width secondary actions compete with the next learning action.
Don't use shadows to compensate for weak hierarchy.
Don't use color as the only signal for completion, availability, expansion, or error.
Don't stretch the phone hierarchy into a wide multi-column web dashboard.
Don't invent Catalog content, progress, badges, or learner claims for visual balance.
